description: Backend controller for managing pages in a Notion clone, including CRUD operations, image handling, and user authorization.

methods.name: getPages
methods.description: Fetches all pages associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific page by ID, with access control based on creator.

methods.name: postPage
methods.description: Creates a new page with provided blocks and associates it with the user.

methods.name: putPage
methods.description: Updates an existing page's blocks if the user has permission.

methods.name: deletePage
methods.description: Deletes a page if the user has permission, and removes associated images.

methods.name: postImage
methods.description: Handles image upload and returns image URL.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image file by name.
